decisions.statement: The edits beside the calling agent's page are folded into one answer.
A fold that refuses refuses the apply and leaves the edits as the edits were.
The folded answer is the change the apply lands.
The edits go once the apply has landed rather than once the fold has read.
A run stopping between the fold and the landing leaves the edits where the fold found the edits.
Only the rows the fold read go.
A run stopping between the landing and the clearing leaves the edits for a later apply.
An edit re-folded onto the body a landing left takes nothing back out.
The edits are formatted after the edits are gathered rather than before.
A body the fold formatted is said to have been formatted.
A gather reads the body an earlier edit left.
Formatting first would leave the later edit reading another body.
A fold that made nothing is put back by nothing.
A row appended while the apply ran follows the rows put back.
A row saying nothing of its readers leaves the readers of that path owing the reading.
A row for a body written again on every apply is dropped rather than folded.
Which bodies those are is read from the index rather than from the path's name.
A row for a body nothing writes again is folded like any other row.
Every row dropped is named in the report.
A run holding nothing but such rows drops those rows and lands nothing.
No warrant runs here.
A row reaching an apply was warranted against the record its writer had.
A row is replayed onto the commit at HEAD rather than onto the tree.
A row that will not replay there refuses the apply and runs no check.
The paths folded in are named in the report before the report the apply makes.
A fold and the apply following that fold are one act.
An apply that refuses puts the folded edits back where the fold found the edits.
Whether the apply landed is read off the landing rather than off the refusals.
An apply that landed puts no fold back.
An agent whose page is nowhere is refused rather than answered with nothing.
That refusal is the refusal every call running a change gives.
The writer owes a reading where any row a fold holds says the writer owes one.
A row says whether the checks run.
A fold runs every check.
What one apply run cost is appended beside the page of the command that ran.
The arguments are read once, and the apply is handed what that reading answered.
An apply whose arguments the reading refused folds nothing.
A landing moving the file a hook link points at writes that link again.
A link already reaching the file the link names is left alone.
A mend that failed is said beside the apply's refusals rather than stopping the apply.
The mend follows the landing, so the run that moved the file is the run that mends.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
An apply answers with the code the applying it ran refused with.
A fold that refuses carries the kind of fault that refusal is.
An apply answers a refused fold with the kind that fold carried.
A fold the kept edits or the bodies beneath refuse is a fault of the data.
An apply waits for the memory a landing starts on before it folds anything.

definition: the edits an agent has answered folded into one change and landed
